data.name: Ward
data.description: The shaman places a protective ward over one creature. The warded creature receives a +%1 deflection bonus to AC and a +%1 resistance bonus on saving throws. This effect lasts until the warded creature is hit or fails a saving throw. A shaman knows when a warded creature is no longer protected. A shaman can have only one ward active at a time. If the shaman uses this hex while a previous ward is still active, that previous ward immediately ends. A shaman cannot use this ability on herself.|ShamanWardHexBonus
